title: centaurea adulterina subsp. numantina
intro: Centaurea adulterina subsp. numantina, commonly known as Mountain Knapweed, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Knapweed include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
